title: Build tension by generating a slow, controlled sequence from one core idea…
content:
Build tension by generating a slow, controlled sequence from one core idea instead of trying to impress early.  
Start with a still, simple establishing shot (e.g., a calm street scene) and keep the moment holding before introducing change.  
Iterate the same scene in small steps: add a minor action (dog approaches), then a pause (dog stops behind cat), then subtle detail shifts (posture, deliberate movement).  
Hint transformation through minimal cues (faint eye light, slight metallic reflections under fur, minimal glow patterns) rather than an abrupt full change.
